Substitute Narrative and Plans for Type 1
Rezoning of 1754 N. Paulina Street
From M1-1 District to a B1-1 District

A. Proposed land use:
Seeking to rezone property from M1-1 to B1-1 in order to use the existing 1 story
building for a preschool, daycare facility.
B. The project’s floor area ratio (FAR) will be 1.2. Actual 0.79.
C. The project’s density is zero. There are no dwelling units.
D. The amount of off-street parking will be 5 parking spaces. Applicant will seek TSL
parking relief, if necessary.
E. Setbacks Existing:
Front: 0’
North: 2.58’
Rear: 0’
South: 20’
F. The existing building height is 20’- 3” high.
The applicant will comply with 17-3-0307 exceptions of the Chicago Air Quality Ordinance

should such provisions be determined as applicable.
